_note: All combat numbers. dmg = damage per hit, rate = hits per second. Armour halves every hit per point unless the attacker pierces. multi = enemies hit per shot (only vs one-hit kills); splash = enemies each shot hits (never more than the gang holds). target toughest = shoots the toughest gang in range (bosses first) instead of the nearest; one_per_shot = a shot never kills more than the one enemy it hits (damage capped at that enemy's hp). unlock = first level where the rank/enemy appears (tools/gen_levels.py reads it). shield = riot-shield hp per unit, soaked before any kill (piercing fire passes). cols/row_gap = gang formation. stop_at = holds that distance and attacks (first_shot s after stopping, then every shoot_every / throw_every s); shoot_range = attacks while still walking (bosses). Gunfire: every shoot_every s each living shooter kills shot_dmg troops. Molotov: every throw_every s the group lobs a firebomb into the lane the squad is in; it lands flight s later and burns `burn` troops per living thrower if the squad is still in that lane. Sniper foe: every shoot_every s, after an `aim` s laser, each living sniper kills shot_dmg. SHIELD blocks all ranged hits and melee. world: lane_width = metres between lane centres; formation_half_width caps how wide the squad's formation gets (so a squad in the middle of its lane never brushes the next lane's obstacle); formation_figures = most figures a formation has (each carries total/figures troops); figure_radius for obstacle overlap; red_gate_clear_s = a red gate's tick never needs more than this many seconds of the squad's fire to reach 0.

input._note: Tap vs swipe (src/core/touch_classifier.gd). A touch that stays within tap_max_px (times the screen scale) and lifts within tap_max_s is a tap: it powers the hero and never steers. Taps count only in the tap zone, from zone_top of the screen height down. Anything that moves further steers.

obstacles._note: Defaults; a level event may override any key. width = footprint across the road (m): an obstacle only hits the troops whose formation slots overlap it, up to its number (fall/dmg or the % forms), so steering half past it saves half the squad. pothole: unshootable, falling in costs `fall` troops (or `fall_pct` % of the squad); the hero always hops over, so it never ends the level. barricade: shoot its hp away or crash into it (dmg troops, or dmg_pct % of the squad) and lose the next gate in that lane. car: shoot it away or crash (dmg or dmg_pct). barrel: shoot it to arm it; it blows up when the next gang's front reaches it, killing up to `kill` gang members in total (nearest gang first).

boosters._note: Pre-level tokens handed to LevelSim in the upgrades dict: headstart = constables per token; shield/bomb tokens add charges like the garage does.

revive._note: Once per level after a loss (rewarded ad): squad back to pct % of its peak, gangs within push metres are shoved back to push, and a shield (s) covers the restart; it outlasts one molotov throw cycle (throw_every + flight) so a firebomb already on its way cannot undo the revive.

stars._note: Fallback star thresholds (percent of peak squad left at the finish) when a level has none.
